records.name: Arvaidas
records.facts_used: Salys lists Arvaidas among Prussian two-stem personal names. He connects Ar- with ar, “also, too”, and sends Vaid- to Vyd-, which he associates with išvysti, “to see”. These are the author’s element comparisons, not a fixed phrase that describes a modern bearer. The 1964 Yla–Salys calendar explicitly places Arvaidas (Arvas) on 1 January; it was reprinted in Salys’s collected writings in 1983. This documents the modern calendar form and its proposed short form. It does not prove uninterrupted use since Prussian times or identify the first Lithuanian child with the name.

records.name: Alo

These episodes concern different periods and uses, not one continuous family history.
